title: Momoi Airi — Solo Show Strategy Meeting!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We promise to cheer for you like there's no tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know you're nervous, Minori, but please try to enjoy your very first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I really appreciate it, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm gonna do the best I can!
I really wanna make the most of my first solo show since I only get one chance to perform in it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural to feel nervous before your first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. But I think what KAITO and the others said helped her with that a little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, more than a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the rest is up to Minori herself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Considering how much she had to overcome to get here, I'm sure she'll do just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, we should keep an eye on her and come up with a plan for when she's not feeling too great.
The next day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Minori seems to be moving even better than yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she is...
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...
That's enough for stretches...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We didn't get much time to practice today since we all had to deal with committee stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I think that allowed us to focus more on the task at hand.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And even though Minori looked like a nervous wreck yesterday, she moved today like none of that was bothering her anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh...?
A message?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I know it's late and I'm really sorry, Airi, but there's something I really need to ask you...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Before practice tomorrow, can we do some special training in secret together like we did during our training camp?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is she talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Based on what I saw today, she seemed to be doing everything that I told her...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I guess she's still pretty concerned...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We don't have much time left until our show, so I am a little worried about her.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah, of course.>
bgm_area00002
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, Airi, Minori, hello.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, KAITO, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're both here awfully early.
I thought you weren't going to practice until much later...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori asked me to hold a special practice session with her!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A special...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Practice session?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hang on. That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like what they did during their training camp♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This sounds like fun.
Would you mind if we join in as well?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You want to join us?
Yes, please!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! What do you need us to do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, would you mind being the audience for us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd like you to see if Minori's performance is able to reach the people all the way in the back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sounds good! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll head to the seats.
Give us the signal when you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, will do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, we need to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... She doesn't seem nervous right now per se...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, Minori...
Do you know if that one fan of yours is gonna be helping with our show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Yuina?
She said she's gonna come see us as a fan this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've sorta only been looking at the messages Saito's been sending us regarding our show... I really wish I had the time to look at fan mail.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Hasegawa's gonna be there too!
She sent an email saying that she received our invitation!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll need to do our best to make her song shine!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... She really doesn't seem that worried or nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, what about the invitations for your parents? Have you had a chance to give them theirs...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! My little brother can't make it because he already has other commitments but my parents said they could!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's great! This is gonna be your chance to really dazzle them with your cuteness!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Hehe. They probably won't know what to do with themselves when they see me performing like a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha! What do you mean “like”? You are a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Where's that nervous wreck I saw the other day? Well, she seems to be in a good place mentally, so I guess I should just let sleeping dogs lie.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Girls! Does here work?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Perfect!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Minori!
They're all set! How about you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's start our special training session!
